title: Mr. & Mrs. Matthew Bernard vs. Ascension Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC ruled the direct appeal administratively out of order because Ascension Presbytery, as the next higher court, had not heard it. The propriety of the excommunication remained undecided.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed the Bernards’ direct appeal from excommunication because they had bypassed Ascension Presbytery, the next higher court.
summary: The Bernards appealed directly to the General Assembly from their excommunication by a Presbytery commission acting as the congregation’s Session. The SJC ruled the appeal administratively out of order because an appeal must first go to the next higher court—Ascension Presbytery—not to the court of original jurisdiction. It did not decide whether the excommunication was proper; that issue remained for Presbytery to hear.
